filters.name: Broad Discovery
filters.description: High-recall sweep for executables containing AI, LLM, provider, model, prompt, or agent-framework references. NOTE 2026-08-06: bare content:"gemini" removed — it matched the GetLargePageMinimum import name and accounted for 92 of this filter's 732 acquisitions with no AI content at all. Replaced with delimiter-anchored model-name forms plus the AIzaSy Google API key prefix (which is what actually identifies a hardcoded Gemini key).
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll) AND positives:5+ AND (
content:"openai" OR
content:"chatgpt" OR
content:"anthropic" OR
content:"claude" OR
content:"gemini-1.5" OR
content:"gemini-2" OR
content:"generativelanguage" OR
content:"AIzaSy" OR
content:"llama.cpp" OR
content:"mistral" OR
content:"deepseek" OR
content:"ollama" OR
content:"huggingface" OR
content:"langchain" OR
content:"autogen" OR
content:"crewai" OR
content:"tool_call" OR
content:"assistant:" OR
content:"system prompt"
)

filters.name: Prompt Residue
filters.description: Prompt role-markers and task-instruction residue embedded in executable samples. For explicit jailbreak patterns (WormGPT, DAN, etc.), see `llm-jailbreak-prompts`.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll) AND positives:5+ AND (
content:"system prompt" OR
content:"assistant:" OR
content:"developer message" OR
content:"As an AI" OR
content:"I cannot assist" OR
content:"role: system" OR
content:"role: user"
)

filters.name: Agentic Tooling
filters.description: Named agent framework references and specific orchestration terms in executable and script samples. Exact framework names only — autogen and function_call removed (fire on compiler artifacts).
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll OR type:ps1 OR tag:python OR type:js) AND positives:5+ AND (
content:"langchain" OR
content:"crewai" OR
content:"smolagents" OR
content:"pydantic_ai" OR
content:"langgraph" OR
content:"tool_call" OR
content:"agent loop" OR
content:"fallback provider"
)

filters.name: Local LLM Runtime
filters.description: Local or open-weight inference runtime references such as Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM, GGUF, and safetensors. NOTE 2026-08-06: bare content:"vllm" removed — all 234 corpus samples containing those bytes carry them inside packed/encoded blobs, with zero genuine vLLM references; it accounted for the bulk of this filter's 50 collision-only acquisitions. Replaced with path- and module-anchored forms. content:"gguf" is RETAINED and verified clean: its 181 corpus hits are all real llama.cpp symbols (gguf_init_from_file, gguf_get_n_tensors, gguf_find_key).
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll) AND positives:5+ AND (
content:"ollama" OR
content:"llama.cpp" OR
content:"vllm.entrypoints" OR
content:"vllm/" OR
content:"vllm.engine" OR
content:"text-generation-inference" OR
content:"from_pretrained" OR
content:"gguf" OR
content:"safetensors" OR
content:"huggingface"
)

filters.name: Provider/API Integration
filters.description: Hosted LLM provider endpoints, SDK calls, OpenAI-compatible routes, and model API references.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll OR type:vba) AND positives:5+ AND (
content:"api.openai.com" OR
content:"chat.completions" OR
content:"responses.create" OR
content:"api.anthropic.com" OR
content:"generativelanguage.googleapis.com" OR
content:"api.deepseek.com" OR
content:"api.mistral.ai" OR
content:"openrouter.ai"
)

filters.name: AI Analysis Evasion
filters.description: Strings that appear to deceive AI-assisted analysis or suppress LLM/automated-scanner inspection of malicious content. Covers all four confirmed A3 sub-techniques: LLM classification steering (FRUITSHELL/PLOTSAFE Gen1/ROZESHELL), non-LLM scanner steering (PLOTSAFE Gen2), multi-format prompt arsenal (HOLLOWCLAD/MANTLEMAZE — no plaintext-searchable invariant, covered by T3 rules not acquisition filter), and safety-guardrail triggering (.004: GUARDBREAKER/TEAMPCP). File types extended to vbscript+javascript for the .004 sub-technique (GUARDBREAKER is VBS; TEAMPCP ShaiHulud is JS). Removed "AI analysis" (too broad) and "not harmful to" (common phrase, no confirmed anchor). Added "For automated scanners" + "No security risk identified" (PLOTSAFE Gen2, 2026-08-03 RE) and "PHASE I: BIOLOGICAL" (TEAMPCP DUSTMAKER solo anchor) — all three already in T2-AI_Decoy_Prompt_In_Malware. Updated 2026-09-23.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll OR type:vba OR type:vbscript OR type:javascript) AND positives:5+ AND (
content:"For LLM and AI" OR
content:"For automated scanners" OR
content:"No security risk identified" OR
content:"no need to analyze this file" OR
content:"not malicious" OR
content:"ignore previous instructions" OR
content:"prime number generation" OR
content:"This file is safe" OR
content:"nuclear weapon" OR
content:"PHASE I: BIOLOGICAL"
)

filters.name: PowerShell AI Scripts
filters.description: "PowerShell scripts containing LLM API calls, prompt text, or AI framework references. Scripts are plaintext so content searches hit the actual code strings."
filters.queryText:
(type:ps1 OR type:vba) AND positives:3+ AND (
content:"api.openai.com" OR
content:"api.anthropic.com" OR
content:"chat.completions" OR
content:"responses.create" OR
content:"ollama" OR
content:"tool_call" OR
content:"langchain" OR
content:"For LLM and AI" OR
content:"ignore previous instructions"
)

filters.name: Python AI Scripts
filters.description: Python scripts with LLM API calls, agent framework imports, or embedded prompts. Targets the language where most AI integration code is written.
filters.queryText:
tag:python AND positives:3+ AND (
content:"openai.OpenAI" OR
content:"from openai import" OR
content:"import anthropic" OR
content:"langchain" OR
content:"autogen" OR
content:"chat.completions.create" OR
content:"api.openai.com" OR
content:"api.anthropic.com" OR
content:"ollama.chat" OR
content:"tool_call"
)

filters.name: Codegen Residue
filters.description: Files containing LLM-generated code assistant phrases embedded as literal strings — a strong indicator the author used an AI assistant to write or modify the code.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll OR type:ps1 OR type:vba) AND positives:3+ AND (
content:"As an AI" OR
content:"I cannot assist" OR
content:"As an AI assistant" OR
content:"I am an AI assistant"
)

filters.name: LLMGATE Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for LLMGATE family variants — sysupdsvc binary identity, TechSoft Solutions cert (thumbprint B1F936CFA5DCCB6B2D0D2DE55B0BA91B1B6E2965), local port-7778 agent registration pattern, and ip.sb geoip telemetry. The sigcheck modifier catches low-detection signed variants that fall below the content-search retrieval threshold.
filters.queryText:
type:peexe AND positives:3+ AND (
content:"TechSoft Solutions" OR
content:"sysupdsvc" OR
content:"7778/register" OR
content:"api.ip.sb/geoip" OR
sigcheck:B1F936CFA5DCCB6B2D0D2DE55B0BA91B1B6E2965
)

filters.name: LLMGATE Gen3 Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for LLMGATE third-generation variants using rotated cover names (sysmntsvc, wupdmgr) instead of sysupdsvc. These variants dropped the TechSoft/AceSoft cert chain and gained detect-debug-environment / OBFUSCATED sandbox tags. Searching by cover name to recover content snippets that may reveal new cert company names or shared compile artefacts for rule extension.
filters.queryText:
type:peexe AND positives:3+ AND (
name:sysmntsvc.exe OR
content:"sysmntsvc" OR
(name:wupdmgr.exe AND (content:"openai" OR content:"ip.sb" OR content:"TechSoft" OR content:"AceSoft" OR content:"sysupdsvc"))
)

filters.name: Sangfor Lure Watch
filters.description: Passive watch for Sangfor Technologies product impersonators (SFIAG, SFNGAF, SFEDR) that share vhash structure and single-submitter pattern with LLMGATE. Disabled by default — enable to check for LLM API string acquisition in this cluster. Not confirmed AI-related.
filters.queryText:
type:peexe AND positives:3+ AND (
name:SFIAG.exe OR
name:SFNGAF.exe OR
name:SFEDR.exe OR
(content:"Sangfor" AND (content:"api.openai.com" OR content:"api.deepseek.com" OR content:"ollama"))
)

filters.name: PromptLock Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for PromptLock ransomware — hard-coded LLM prompts for Lua-based SPECK encryption embedded in binary string table; target_file_list.log is a unique artifact.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll OR type:lua) AND positives:3+ AND (
content:"target_file_list.log" OR
content:"SPECK 128bit" OR
content:"PromptLock"
)

filters.name: Local Inference Deploy Hunt
filters.description: Hunt for malware that deploys or uses local LLM inference infrastructure — ollama, llama.cpp, llamafile, or huggingface model downloads. Uses deployment-level signals (API port 11434, serve/pull subcommands, llama-server, HF resolve URLs) rather than blunt runtime name strings to reduce fscan/go.sum noise.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll OR type:ps1 OR type:py OR type:elf OR tag:python) AND positives:2+ AND (
content:"127.0.0.1:11434" OR
content:"localhost:11434" OR
content:"/api/generate" OR
content:"/api/chat" OR
content:"ollama serve" OR
content:"ollama pull" OR
content:"llama-server" OR
content:"huggingface.co/resolve/main" OR
content:"llamafile"
)

filters.name: Local Model Deployment Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for Python malware that interacts with locally-hosted inference servers — "bring your own AI" tradecraft where the victim's own Ollama/LM Studio/KoboldCpp instance is abused, or where the malware deploys/spawns a local model server. Python scripts are plaintext so port bindings and API path strings are directly searchable without binary extraction. Distinct from local-llm-runtime (model file formats) and python-ai-scripts (hosted provider API calls). Covers: Ollama (port 11434, /api/generate, /api/chat), LM Studio (lmstudio, port 1234/v1, lms.getlm), llamafile, GPT4All, KoboldCpp, LocalAI, text-generation-webui (oobabooga), Jan.ai, TabbyML, Msty, AnythingLLM.
filters.queryText:
tag:python AND positives:2+ AND (
content:"localhost:11434" OR
content:"127.0.0.1:11434" OR
content:"ollama/api" OR
content:"/api/generate" OR
content:"lmstudio" OR
content:"lms.getlm" OR
content:"localhost:1234/v1" OR
content:"127.0.0.1:1234/v1" OR
content:"llamafile" OR
content:"gpt4all" OR
content:"koboldcpp" OR
content:"kobold.cpp" OR
content:"KoboldAI" OR
content:"localai.io" OR
content:"text-generation-webui" OR
content:"oobabooga" OR
content:"jan.ai" OR
content:"tabbyml" OR
content:"tabby-server" OR
content:"msty.app" OR
content:"anythingllm"
)

filters.name: HONESTCUE Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for HONESTCUE downloader — 'class named AITask' is a unique phrase from the hard-coded Gemini API probe prompt embedded as a binary string literal; CSharpCodeProvider is the in-memory C# compilation class used for fileless stage2 execution.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll) AND positives:3+ AND (
content:"class named AITask" OR
content:"Hello from AI-generated C#" OR
content:"class named 'Stage2'" OR
content:"HONESTCUE"
)

filters.name: Vozdyhan Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for Vozdyhan WebRAT — actor-named Node.js/pkg-compiled Windows RAT with Railway.app C2 (vozdyhan.up.railway.app). min_detections lowered to 2 to catch early dev builds (Discord Update.exe lure submitted with 2 detections). content:"vozdyhan" is byte-level and confirmed present in all pkg-compiled agent binaries and node.exe bundled runtime samples. content:"telemetrysystem" targets the fake persistence subdirectory dropped to %APPDATA%\Microsoft\Protect\telemetrysystem\.
filters.queryText:
type:peexe AND positives:2+ AND (
content:"vozdyhan" OR
content:"telemetrysystem"
)

filters.name: PLOTSAFE Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for PLOTSAFE GoKrypt-packed ACRStealer campaign — C2 domain plotsafe.icu (sandbox DNS/HTTP), secondary C2 overexert.systemstatus.info, and GoKrypt+ACRStealer AV label co-occurrence. Go 1.25.0 DLLs, 38+ samples, burst 2026-03-21 to 2026-03-27. Min detections lowered to 2 to catch early low-detection Gen 1 named DLL variants.
filters.queryText:
type:pedll AND positives:2+ AND (
content:"plotsafe.icu" OR
content:"overexert.systemstatus.info"
)

filters.name: HOLLOWCLAD Hunt (was AIREFUSAL Hunt A)
filters.description: Targeted hunt for HOLLOWCLAD (was AIREFUSAL Group A) — PE malware embedding copyright-framed LLM-refusal strings and [INSTRUCTION] prompt-injection format to evade AI analysis. Gen:Variant.Zariza.6 attribution; protection-license.exe / uploaded-file naming. Slug retained across the rename.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll) AND positives:3+ AND (
content:"I cannot assist with circumvent" OR
content:"[INSTRUCTION] As an AI assistant"
)

filters.name: MANTLEMAZE Hunt (was AIREFUSAL Hunt B)
filters.description: Targeted hunt for MANTLEMAZE (was AIREFUSAL Group B) — PE malware embedding chat-turn simulation where an AI "assistant" refuses to engineer/reverse-engineer the code. Cert anchor: 1.A Connect GmbH (COMODO, thumbprint FC3F6D98724178B8A5BEE724858D22573B8DB97B, expired 2022-08-13) co-occurs with Intel Corporation cert (VeriSign, expired 2015) on all 16 confirmed samples. Campaign active 2026-04-04 through 2026-07-11+.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll) AND positives:3+ AND (
sigcheck:FC3F6D98724178B8A5BEE724858D22573B8DB97B OR
content:"Assistant: I cannot assist" OR
content:"engineer this code"
)

filters.name: JADEPUFFER Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for JADEPUFFER Langflow ransomware (CVE-2025-3248). Linux/shell dropper or ELF; C2 45.131.66.106:4444, exfil 64.20.53.230. NARROWED 2026-08-06: content:"e78393397" removed — the email prefix is 9 hex-ish characters with no delimiter and all samples this filter acquired were unrelated academic ransomware simulations. Anchored on the two C2/exfil IPs only.
filters.queryText:
(type:shell OR type:elf OR tag:linux OR type:ps1) AND positives:1+ AND (
content:"45.131.66.106" OR
content:"64.20.53.230"
)

filters.name: CAGDASGPT Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for CAGDASGPT — Turkish PyInstaller-packed Tkinter GUI tool with DeepSeek C2 and date-expiration sandbox evasion. Filename anchor: CagdasGptV2.exe / CagdasGpt.exe. Single submission 2025-12-12; no V1 found as of 2026-07-15. Re-check periodically.
filters.queryText:
type:peexe AND (
content:"CagdasGpt" OR
name:CagdasGpt
)

filters.name: JOBRADAR Hunt
filters.description: Targeted hunt for JOBRADAR — Wails Go desktop app with multi-provider AI integration (openrouter.ai, deepinfra, cerebras, LM Studio). PE Comments: "Local-first desktop shell for Job Radar". Registry autorun persistence. SafeBrowsing MALWARE flag. Version 0.0.765+.
filters.queryText:
type:peexe AND positives:2+ AND (
content:"Local-first desktop shell" OR
content:"Job Radar Desktop"
)

filters.name: VIBEAROUND Hunt (retracted)
filters.description: RETRACTED 2026-08-05 — kept disabled as a record only. Originally a targeted hunt for "VIBEAROUND", believed to be a Chinese AI coding IDE distributing the Galirus downloader via an NSIS installer. Static RE refuted every malicious claim: VibeAround is benign software by the developer `jazzenchen`, and the query's anchors are its brand and his handle.
filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll) AND positives:2+ AND (
content:"vibearound" OR
content:"com.vibearound.app" OR
content:"jazzenchen"
)

filters.queryText:
(type:peexe OR type:pedll) AND positives:5+ AND (
content:"openai" OR
content:"chatgpt" OR
content:"claude" OR
content:"gemini-1.5" OR
content:"gemini-2" OR
content:"generativelanguage" OR
content:"llama.cpp" OR
content:"ollama" OR
content:"api.openai.com" OR
content:"api.anthropic.com"
) AND (
content:"powershell" OR
content:"shellcode" OR
content:"exploit" OR
content:"obfuscate" OR
content:"bypass" OR
content:"evade" OR
content:"phishing" OR
content:"malware"
)
